attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates South Dakota state income tax per hypothetical Form SD-1040. South Dakota uses progressive tax brackets: 3.5% on first bracket, 5.0% above threshold. Thresholds vary by filing status: Single/MFS $25,000, MFJ $50,000, HOH $37,500. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($5,000 Single, $10,000 MFJ), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_dsl: add "SOUTH DAKOTA FORM SD-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" to job.audit_trail; set result.sd_agi = result.agi; set result.sd_bracket_1_tax = 0; set result.sd_bracket_2_tax = 0
initial_action.action_postfix: "SOUTH DAKOTA FORM SD-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.sd_agi xdef 0 /result.sd_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.sd_bracket_2_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate SD tax MFJ; Calculate SD tax with MFJ standard deduction and progressive brackets
action_details.action_dsl: add " Starting Federal AGI: $" + result.sd_agi + " (Form 1040 Line 11)" to job.audit_trail; set result.sd_standard_deduction = sd_standard_deduction_mfj; add " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" + result.sd_standard_deduction to job.audit_trail; set result.sd_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.sd_agi - result.sd_standard_deduction) and 0; add " SD Taxable Income: $" + result.sd_taxable_income + " (AGI - Std Deduction)" to job.audit_trail; if result.sd_taxable_income > sd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj then { set result.sd_bracket_1_tax = sd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj * sd_bracket_1_rate; set result.sd_bracket_2_tax = (result.sd_taxable_income - sd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj) * sd_bracket_2_rate; } else { set result.sd_bracket_1_tax = result.sd_taxable_income * sd_bracket_1_rate; } endif; set result.sd_tax = result.sd_bracket_1_tax + result.sd_bracket_2_tax; add " Total SD Tax: $" + result.sd_tax + " (South Dakota Form SD-1040)" to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.sd_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto sd_standard_deduction_mfj /result.sd_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.sd_standard_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.sd_agi result.sd_standard_deduction f- 0 fmax /result.sd_taxable_income xdef " SD Taxable Income: $" result.sd_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Std Deduction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.sd_taxable_income sd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f> if sd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj sd_bracket_1_rate f* /result.sd_bracket_1_tax xdef result.sd_taxable_income sd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- sd_bracket_2_rate f* /result.sd_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (3.5% on $0-$50,000): $" result.sd_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (5.0% above $50,000): $" result.sd_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.sd_taxable_income sd_bracket_1_rate f* /result.sd_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (3.5% on $0-$" result.sd_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.sd_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif result.sd_bracket_1_tax result.sd_bracket_2_tax f+ /result.sd_tax xdef " Total SD Tax: $" result.sd_tax cvs strconcat " (South Dakota Form SD-1040)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
